title: Branches
subtitle: Manage branch profiles, POS access, invoice settings, and module visibility across every location.
zatcaNoticeTitle: Branch ZATCA setup is separate for each location
zatcaNoticeBody: Each branch needs its own Phase 2 onboarding and certificate setup. After adding or updating a branch, continue in ZATCA from the sidebar.

editor.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
editor.resetSuccessBody: The branch can now log in with the new password.
editor.drawerHelp: Configure invoice and ZATCA settings for this location
editor.logoHelp: PNG, JPG, WebP · max 5 MB · shown on invoices
editor.companyNameHelp: Your registered business name. This appears on ZATCA invoices and certificates.
editor.vatHelp: From your VAT Registration Certificate. Must be 15 digits starting and ending with 3.
editor.crHelp: Commercial Registration number for this specific branch. Each branch has its own CR.
editor.districtHelp: Neighbourhood or district name as in your registered address.
editor.postalHelp: 5-digit postal code from your Saudi National Address document.
editor.usernameHelp: Username for POS and branch dashboard access
editor.legacyEmailHelp: Legacy email login for POS and branch dashboard access
editor.usernameNotSetBranch: Username not set for this branch.
editor.credentialsHelp: Set username credentials for this branch's POS terminal. No email is sent—share these directly with your staff.
editor.usernameFormatHelp: Use letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens.

pos.title: Billing Interface
pos.help: Choose the POS screen this branch opens by default.

touch.label: Touch POS
touch.description: Best for cafés, restaurants, service counters, and businesses using visual product cards.

quick.label: Quick Billing
quick.description: Best for trading, wholesale, retail, warehouses, and businesses that search products by name, SKU, or barcode.

pos.splitHelp: Cashiers can split one invoice between cash and card.
pos.arrowsHelp: Adds large arrow buttons for category and product navigation on touch screens.

stock.title: Stock module
stock.help: Use Stock if this branch tracks physical stock items such as packaged goods, accessories, or resale items.
stock.visible: Stock will be visible in the branch sidebar.
stock.hidden: Stock will be hidden from the branch sidebar.
stock.serviceDefault: Default for service businesses: Stock is hidden.
stock.tradingDefault: Default for trading businesses: Stock is visible.
stock.scopeHelp: Stock controls the branch Stock page visibility. Purchases remain available for supplier bills and materials.

invoice.exclusiveHelp: VAT added on top of price
invoice.footerPlaceholder: Thank you for your purchase! · شكراً لتسوقكم معنا
invoice.showLogoHelp: Displays the branch logo at the top of every invoice

zatca.phase2Help: UBL 2.1 e-invoice + ZATCA clearance — set by your plan
zatca.phase1Help: QR Code (TLV) generation — set by your plan
zatca.certificateHelp: Managed from ZATCA in the owner sidebar after saving branch details.

validation.vat: Must be 15 digits, starting and ending with 3
validation.usernameInvalid: Use 3–32 lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.

errors.loginSetupFailed: Branch created, but login setup failed. Cancel to close and review the branch login.
errors.posPermission: You do not have permission to update POS checkout settings for this branch.
errors.posUnavailable: The POS settings update is not available yet. Contact support, then refresh and try again.
errors.posRejected: The POS checkout settings were rejected. Refresh and try again.
errors.posSaveFailed: Failed to save POS checkout settings.
errors.modulePermission: You do not have permission to update module settings for this branch.
errors.moduleUnavailable: The Stock module setting is not available yet. Contact support, then refresh and try again.

card.deleteHelp: Contact Kubri support to delete this branch.

list.emptyBody: Add your first branch to start generating ZATCA-ready invoices
